title: Redis cache crashes repeatedly
reason: Engineer correctly identifies cache crash but attributes it to Redis upgrade instead of the new Lua script in API 2.3.2.
root_cause: The cache container crashes with Redis 7.4 segmentation‑faults caused by a bug introduced when upgrading from Redis 7.2 nine days ago.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced a new Lua script for atomic cart updates that triggers a segmentation fault in Redis 7.4, causing the cache to crash and restart every few minutes under load.
